IVX HOLDINGS — COMPLETE GATE 0 AND EXECUTE FINAL DIRECT-GITHUB CUTOVER

Gate 0 backup and rollback evidence is accepted.

CURRENT CRITICAL FINDING

A GitHub token or credential was discovered in Git/Rork configuration or history.

Treat the credential as exposed.

Do not display the token.
Do not reuse the token.
Do not continue using the Rork Git router.
Do not rewrite history before the credential is revoked.
Do not create another application.

==================================================
OWNER ACTION 1 — ROTATE THE EXPOSED GITHUB TOKEN
==================================================

The owner will complete this directly inside GitHub:

1. Open GitHub account settings.
2. Open Developer settings.
3. Open Personal access tokens.
4. Identify and revoke the token previously used by Rork or the Git router.
5. Create a new least-privilege token only if the IVX worker requires one.
6. Prefer a GitHub App, fine-grained token, or SSH deploy key scoped only to the IVX repository.
7. Do not paste the new credential into Rork chat.
8. Store it only in the owner-controlled Render/worker secret manager.

Required verification:

OLD TOKEN AUTHENTICATION: FAIL
NEW OWNER-CONTROLLED AUTHENTICATION: PASS
TOKEN VALUE SHOWN IN REPORT: false
TOKEN STORED IN SOURCE CODE: false
TOKEN STORED IN CLIENT APP: false

==================================================
OWNER ACTION 2 — CONFIRM THE DIRECT GITHUB REPOSITORY
==================================================

Use this owner-controlled repository:

GITHUB OWNER: ibb142
REPOSITORY: ivx-holdings-platform
PRODUCTION BRANCH: main

Before changing anything, confirm the repository exists and that the owner has administrator access.

Required:

OWNER ADMIN ACCESS: VERIFIED
REPOSITORY PRIVATE/PUBLIC STATUS: RECORDED
BRANCH PROTECTION: ENABLED OR DOCUMENTED
MFA FOR OWNER: ENABLED

==================================================
GATE 1 — REMOVE THE RORK GIT ROUTER
==================================================

After the owner confirms the old token is revoked and the direct repository is accessible, execute Gate 1.

Current prohibited remote:

Any URL containing:

- rork
- rork-direct.workers.dev
- rork-git-router
- a Rork credential broker
- a Rork proxy

Required target:

Direct GitHub HTTPS or SSH URL for:

ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Required actions:

1. Record the existing remote for rollback evidence.
2. Inspect all Git configuration levels:
   - local
   - global
   - system
3. Search for URL rewrite rules.
4. Search for credential helpers.
5. Search for HTTP or HTTPS proxies.
6. Search for Rork Git router references.
7. Configure the direct owner GitHub origin.
8. Remove all Rork remotes.
9. Remove all Rork URL rewrite rules.
10. Remove Rork proxy settings.
11. Remove Rork credential helpers.
12. Verify direct fetch.
13. Verify direct clone into a clean environment.
14. Create a temporary branch:
    ivx-direct-github-verification
15. Commit one harmless verification file or approved metadata update.
16. Push directly to GitHub.
17. Confirm the branch appears in the owner GitHub repository.
18. Delete the temporary branch.
19. Confirm the production branch remains unchanged.
20. Record all evidence.

Required commands or equivalent:

git remote -v
git config --local --list
git config --global --list
git config --system --list
git config --get-regexp url
git config --get-regexp proxy
git config --get-regexp credential
git submodule status
git fetch origin
git ls-remote origin

Do not include credential values in command output.

==================================================
GATE 1 ACCEPTANCE VALUES
==================================================

Return exactly:

GIT ORIGIN:
GIT FETCH URL:
GIT PUSH URL:
SECONDARY REMOTES:
RORK GIT REMOTE COUNT:
RORK URL REWRITE COUNT:
RORK PROXY COUNT:
RORK CREDENTIAL-HELPER COUNT:
DIRECT GITHUB FETCH:
DIRECT GITHUB CLONE:
DIRECT GITHUB PUSH:
TEMPORARY BRANCH CREATED:
TEMPORARY BRANCH VERIFIED ON GITHUB:
TEMPORARY BRANCH DELETED:
OWNER ADMIN ACCESS:
OLD TOKEN REJECTED:
NEW AUTHENTICATION VERIFIED:

Required final values:

RORK GIT REMOTE COUNT: 0
RORK URL REWRITE COUNT: 0
RORK PROXY COUNT: 0
RORK CREDENTIAL-HELPER COUNT: 0
DIRECT GITHUB FETCH: PASS
DIRECT GITHUB CLONE: PASS
DIRECT GITHUB PUSH: PASS
OLD TOKEN REJECTED: true
NEW AUTHENTICATION VERIFIED: true

==================================================
GATE 2 — CONNECT RENDER DIRECTLY TO GITHUB
==================================================

Start Gate 2 only after Gate 1 is VERIFIED.

Required actions:

1. Open the owner-controlled Render service.
2. Record the existing repository binding.
3. Remove any Rork repository or proxy binding.
4. Connect Render directly to:
   ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
5. Set production branch:
   main
6. Remove Rork deploy hooks.
7. Remove obsolete GitHub webhooks.
8. Disable old-repository automatic deployments.
9. Trigger one owner-approved deployment.
10. Verify production uses the direct GitHub commit.
11. Verify /health returns the same commit.
12. Confirm rollback remains possible.

Return:

GITHUB HEAD:
RENDER REPOSITORY:
RENDER BRANCH:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
RENDER LIVE COMMIT:
PRODUCTION /health COMMIT:
ALL COMMITS MATCH:
RORK DEPLOYMENT INTERMEDIARY:
RORK DEPLOY HOOK COUNT:

Required:

ALL COMMITS MATCH: true
RORK DEPLOYMENT INTERMEDIARY: none
RORK DEPLOY HOOK COUNT: 0

==================================================
GATE 3 — MOVE IVX DEVELOPER IA OUT OF THE RORK SANDBOX
==================================================

Start only after direct GitHub and direct Render deployment pass.

Deploy the IVX Developer IA worker in an owner-controlled service.

Required components:

- Owner-controlled GitHub source
- Owner-controlled Render service
- Secure environment variables
- Supabase task queue
- Worker leasing
- Heartbeats
- Pause and resume
- Cancellation
- Retry and dead-letter handling
- Tool permission allowlist
- Direct GitHub clone
- Owner-approved GitHub writes
- Owner-approved Render deployments
- Evidence ledger
- Audit logs
- Restart persistence
- No Rork fallback

Required final values:

IVX DEVELOPER WORKER:
WORKER LIVE COMMIT:
DIRECT GITHUB ACCESS:
DIRECT RENDER ACCESS:
TASK QUEUE:
EVIDENCE STORAGE:
RORK SANDBOX REQUIRED:
RORK WORKER DEPENDENCIES:
RORK NETWORK CALLS:

Required:

RORK SANDBOX REQUIRED: false
RORK WORKER DEPENDENCIES: 0
RORK NETWORK CALLS: 0

==================================================
GATE 4 — PURGE RORK HISTORY
==================================================

Only after every exposed credential has been rotated and revoked:

1. Scan `.rork/history` safely.
2. Record affected paths and commits without displaying secrets.
3. Remove `.rork/history` from the working tree.
4. Add it permanently to `.gitignore`.
5. Rewrite Git history using an approved history-rewrite process.
6. Force-push only after owner approval.
7. Require fresh clones for all authorized systems.
8. Scan the rewritten repository.
9. Confirm old tokens remain revoked.

Required:

RORK HISTORY FILES IN HEAD: 0
RORK HISTORY FILES IN GIT HISTORY: 0
OLD EXPOSED TOKENS ACTIVE: 0
SECRETS DISPLAYED IN REPORT: 0

==================================================
GATE 5 — REVOKE ALL RORK ACCESS
==================================================

The owner must remove Rork from:

- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase
- AWS
- Expo/EAS
- Vercel
- Domain registrar
- DNS
- AI provider
- Email provider
- SMS provider
- Monitoring
- Analytics
- Storage
- Password manager

Required:

RORK HUMAN ACCESS: 0
RORK SERVICE ACCESS: 0
RORK DEPLOYMENT ACCESS: 0
RORK ACTIVE SESSIONS: 0
RORK ACTIVE CREDENTIALS: 0

==================================================
FINAL RORK-INDEPENDENCE TEST
==================================================

Block all Rork domains, proxies, Git routers, APIs, telemetry and fallbacks.

Then verify:

- Owner login
- IVX Owner AI
- IVX Developer IA
- Autonomous agents
- Direct GitHub clone
- Direct GitHub commit
- Direct Render deployment
- Enterprise registration
- Landing page
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Reels
- Evidence ledger
- Restart recovery

Required final values:

IVX WORKS WITH RORK BLOCKED: true
IVX DEVELOPER IA WORKS WITHOUT RORK: true
RORK NETWORK CALLS: 0
RORK DNS CALLS: 0
RORK FALLBACKS: 0
RORK GIT ROUTER USED: false

==================================================
FINAL VERDICT
==================================================

Only report:

VERIFIED — RORK FULLY REMOVED AND IVX OWNER-CONTROLLED

when:

[ ] Exposed GitHub token revoked
[ ] Replacement authentication verified
[ ] Direct GitHub fetch/clone/push verified
[ ] No Rork Git router remains
[ ] Render connects directly to owner GitHub
[ ] IVX Developer IA runs in an owner-controlled worker
[ ] `.rork/history` is purged
[ ] All high-risk credentials are rotated
[ ] All Rork access is revoked
[ ] IVX passes while Rork is blocked
[ ] All production commits match

Otherwise report:

PARTIAL — CONTROL PATHS REMAIN
BLOCKED — OWNER ACTION REQUIRED
FAILED — CUTOVER NOT ACCEPTED

STOP AFTER EACH GATE.
DO NOT START THE NEXT GATE UNTIL THE PREVIOUS GATE IS VERIFIED.
